line: Dude, you know what we should do?
What?
We should write a hit song.
Yea-yuh, we should!
Okay, okay. Check it out. Just do what I do, and watch the hit song com-a rollin' in.
Okay.
♪Ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha.♪
♪Ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha.♪
♪Ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha.♪
♪Ha, ha, ha,-♪
♪-ha, ha, ha-♪
♪-he, ha, ha!♪
♪He, he, ha!♪
♪Ha, ha, ha, ha, ha!♪
♪Ting, ting, ting, ting, ting, ting, ting, beep, beep, beep, boop.♪
What are you doing?
(As he and Rigby grab their rakes.) Sorry, Benson. We were trying to write a hit song.
What?
We were trying to-
We ca-
Just because you think we can't do it, doesn't mean we can't.
(As he comes out though the middle window on his house on top.) Yes?
Can Mordecai and Rigby write a hit song?
Oh... No.
Oh, yeah? We'll show you.
(Off-screen) Yo, are you the owner of this record company?
(Off-screen) Well, check this out.
(Off-screen) ♪Ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha-♪
Aww! Oh, okay! Okay, were leaving!
Uh... Okay... We can't write a hit song...
Are you finished now?
Yes...
Aw, man. I guess we're not good enough to write a hit song.
Yeah... But I bet we're good enough to come up with an awesome ringtone.
Yeah, we are!
♪Ra-ha, ringtone, pick up your phone.♪
♪Ra-ha, ringtone, pick up your phone.♪

♪Ra-ha, ringtone, pick up the phone, ra-ha, ringtone, pick up your phone! Ra-ha, ringtone, pick the phone! Ting, ting, ting, ting, ting, ting, ting, beep, beep, beep, boop. Pick up your telephone, because you hear your ringtone!♪
Woooah!!
Woooah!!
♪Aha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha, ha-ha.♪
Yeah, two whole bags of leaves. I can't even feel my arms.
It works great.
In fact, I need you to install three more. That should be easy for you, right, big guy?
Augh! It's not fair! Why do I always get stuck with the hard jobs?
Well, you are the strong one, I mean, you are called "Muscle Man".
Is that all I am to you, just a Muscle Man? Why doesn't Skips do the hard jobs? He's strong.
Oh, so he gets a cushy desk job while I get stuck with manual labor?
Hey, I'm good with numbers.

Well, guess what? I'm sick of this job, and I'm sick of everyone just using me for my body. I'm gonna prove to you all that I'm just as smart as I am strong. I'm gonna leave the park and get an office job!
Why would you do that?
Yeah, working at an office doesn't prove that you're smart.
I give him three days.
I heard you guys had some jobs.
Yeah, intelligent and smart, that's me.
Where's Ron?
Randy.
Andy.
We're the Cube Bros. We're not your typical office drones.
Woaaaah...kay!
Well, I guess I'm replacing Ron.
Oh, wait, are you the guy who opened the pickle jar?
Yeah!
Pssh. It'll take a lot more than that to replace Ron.
Any sack of meat can open a pickle jar.
Look, It's not just 'cause I opened that jar, I'm smart, too, okay?
Oh, look, 12:00. Time for our corporately mandated lunch.
Hey, mind if I come?
I'll show you.
Whoa, good catch. Looks like someone's been studying up on "Data Ethics, Volume 6".
Whoa, those books are massive!
And smart.
Oh, yeah, sure. Sure, now that you've read all those books, you're up to protocol.
You know who else is up to protocol? My mo...nitor!
Dude, I miss the days when we didn't have to move cinderblocks.
I miss the days when we didn't have to do Muscle Man's work.
And I miss the way Muscle Man would make me smile with his cool sense of humor after a long day of work.
Dude, we gotta go beg him to come back.
Hey, Muscle Ma--
We really need you back!
Who are these guys, Mitchell?
Randy, Andy, Gil, meet my old co-workers, Mordecai, Rigby and Fives. Park Bros, Cube Bros.
Park Bros? More like College Dropout Bros, am I right?
But seriously, guys, that's a little harsh.
Well, Mitchell, we came to announce the good news.
As of today, you're officially being promoted to corporate.
Whoa, really?
Well, we think you're ready.
WHOOOOO!!!!
I don't know, Muscle Man. Do you really want to be stuck in a box all day? This isn't you!
Yeah, forget this place and come back to the Park already!
And lift heavy pipes for the rest of my life? Forget that! For once, I've found a place that appreciates me for more than just my body. I thought you guys would be happy for me.
Well, now that you've ditched those losers, we gotta show you to your new office.
Whoa! That's Ron? This dude definitely didn't skip leg day.
RON! What is this?!
The giant hamster wheel generator that powers Omnitech.
Our office drone bodies are weak. Your brutish strength will keep the wheel moving to run Omnitech's power generator.
So, you just wanted me for my body all along?
Yeah, or else we won't work-work-work-work-work!
Muscle Man!
We gotta save him!
Omnitech: Powered by People!
Give us back our friend!
What's hamboning?!
This place is gonna blow!
Whoa, corporate carnage. Thanks for helping me out, you guys.  That escalated really quickly.
Yeah, you really dodged a bullet on that one.
I still wish I could prove that I'm more than just a Muscle Man. Maybe I'm not as smart as I thought.
Oh, you're smart, just a different kind of smart. You just have to find your own way of showing it.
I think I got one more idea that will prove that I'm smart.
But seriously, folks, I checked his computer, right? And I told him, he has a pretty bad virus. You know who else has a pretty bad virus? My motherboard!
Hurry!
Sssshhh...
Huddle!
I don't know about these guys.
We shouldn't trust them.
Guys, we're drifting in space. They could be our only chance.
They could be our only chance.
How do we know if they're actually going to help us?
We could just ask them.
Well, who's gonna ask?
Ah! Fine.
Bro bots, can you help us get back to Earth?
Huh. I can't believe I never noticed this before.
Wow. You hear that, guys? Manual labour is gonna save our lives. Everybody grab a Bro Bot and get to work.
Dude, there's something shady about those guys.
Let's follow them.
Dude, maybe we're wrong about these guys. They actually seem pretty nice.
Yeah, too nice. They did say they were gonna kill us with kindness. Killing is killing, dude.
You're being paranoid.
Don't call me paranoid. It makes me paranoid.
Shh, shh. Wait.
Aha! Aha! What did I tell you?
Hmm-hmm. Let's follow him.
Dude, we gotta get in there.
But how? We're not robots.
Hmm...
Zer-OOOOOOOOHHHHHHHH!
Reaper Bot?!
Those liars! They had us right from the start.
Look at all this stuff.
They must be harvesting plants from all over the galaxy.
This one's craz-o.
Dude, come. You might wanna look at this.
Reaper Bots? Really?
It's true! They're stealing all out plants and harvesting them for their own.
We saw it ourselves.
That's ridiculous. They're the best thing to happen to us since we left Earth.
They're the only thing that's ever happened to us.
Lemonade, my favorite.
No!
We're not buying it, Robots!
Or should I say Reaper Bots!
We found your evil plan. See.
But you drew X's over out faces.
A likely story...
... for a liar!
Someone tried to warn us about you.
Huh?
Trust no one.
Pizza is the oldest trick in the book.
Yeah.
Not cool, bros.
Why are you guys being so mean to them?
Don't go.
Don't listen to those bozos. They were just about to leave.
But -
Just get inside. Now!
Who are you people?
You don't know who you are?
These robots are harvesting your natural resources as we speak.
You filthy metalheads only help others to help yourself.
Well, this is certainly a pickle. I'm not sure who we can trust.
I put my money on the new guys. Look.
What is that thing, brobots?
Hey, baby blue. You want some more? Come get it.
Loud and clear.
Hole in one.
It's not working.
Dude, you found his weak spot.
I hate to bust your chops but logging season is over.
Wow, those robots really had us fooled.
It's like my father always told me - If someone's being nice to you, they probably have ulterior motives. Sorry we didn't believe you guys.
It's okay, Benson.
Yeah, no hard feelings. Not everyone's as smart as we is.
Control room?
This is just Pops' room.
Are you taking us back to Earth?
Alright, dude. Ready?
With precision...
Dude, that was like really close this time!
(yells) This is a pressure washer! Do you know how to use it? You better, otherwise, I'm gonna fire you!
Come on; I want to use the wand.
Alright, dude. Give me some juice, but start slow!
Ok, this is good.
Are you sure you don't want it higher? There are all these other numbers on here!
Nope.
I can't take this! I'm turning it up!
No! Don't do it!
I can help!
So I can pick up my car tomorrow? That's great!
Mordecai, help!
Dude, I'm trying!
Dude, who turned it off?
Oh, no.
Sorry, Benson. We know.
Yeah. We'll re-paint some of the messed up parts.
That's not good enough! You have to re-paint the whole thing or the paint won't match!
What?!
But the whole thing's like the size of the house!
Yeah. That's the idea. You have till the end of the weekend.
UGH!
Geez, typical Benson, right dude?
Whatever. Let's just get started.
You know, I was right there with you until the whole "get started" part. We got all weekend! Let's go play some video games. You know, bro out.
No.
Have some bro time.
Rigby!
Get in the bro zone?
Just stop it, okay?
Alright, what gives?
Come on, dude. I bet we can finish it all today. Then you can still see CJ tomorrow. I mean, we paint stuff all the time, right?
I don't know.
We get some tunes, some suiters, and bro it out like a couple bros.
(chuckles) Alright, dude. Classic bro time. Let's do it.
Ugh! We're not gonna finish this today! You totally tricked me with your bro talk.
Relax. You'll still be able to hang out with CJ.
How will I do that if I'm stuck here painting walls all day? This wouldn't have happened if you just listened to me in the first place!
Okay. I can see how this is kinda my fault.
Kinda?
Ok, ok. More than kinda. Look, you go hang out with CJ. I'll finish this up.
Yeah, right. The whole thing?
It's ok. I got this.
Really?
Yeah, no problem.
(sternly) Really?
Yeah, you go. Bros helping bros.
(sighs) Well, thanks. (walks off) I'll see you when it's done.
Alright! Solo bro. Uno bro. Bro number one. Bro number two is with his lady. And that's cool with bro number one. Brody bro bro bro. One bro. (pauses, then goes inside) Time for a bro break.
I hope you saved room for desert!
Oh, we always save room...for donuts!
Aw yeyeyeyeeyeah!
Return to "Carter & Briggs meet RGB2" after these messages.
Woah!
This week only, be a part of our new experimental test phase and we'll paint your house for FREE! Call now!
(swiftly) A subsidiary of the US government.
Huh?
What the-?!
Afternoon, citizen.
Who are you?
I'm a Stealth Co. agent from Stealth Co. Corporation.
Wait, I was just calling a Stealth Co. about getting my house painted.
I know. Just need you to sign the contract.
Ok.
Dude, this is like a million pages long!
(flips page) Just sign here to get started.
(flips page again) And here.
Uh, initials here for us to paint the inside.
And it's still free, right?
Mm-hmm.
(places initials) Nice!
Fingerprint here.
Retinal scan. Aaaaaand blood sample.
Excellent, you are a true patriot. We'll be done in a few hours. Go ahead, go relax.
And please accept this complimentary fleece pullover, courtesy of Stealth Co.
Wow!
I don't know, it's just one of those things where it's like, "whoa". You know?
(chuckles) Yeah, I totally know.
Hey, Mordecai.
Shouldn't you be painting the house?
Oh, should I? (to Eileen) Your most relaxing drink, please.
I'm on it.
Yes, you should. Quit messin' around and go finish the job!
You can call off you dogs, Mordecai. I'm done. Because I listened to you.
See? You have nothing to worry about.
Yeah, alright. Cool. Thanks, Rigby.
No problembro.
Eileen, this is just hot water.
It's good for your digestion.
So what do you wanna do for the rest of the weekend?
I don't know. Maybe check out that loaded potato place.
(looks ahead) What?!
It's a baked potato filled with stuff.
No, look. Rigby, where's the house?
I don't know. It's supposed to be right- ooh!
Ow! What happened?
Okay, this is weird. What did you do?
I...You know, I just hired some professionals.
Rigby!
Woah. What? What kind of guys did you hire?
Professional guys! They seemed legit! I even signed this contract.
Rigby, this says "Stealth Co."! They made our house stealth!
(gasps) What does stealth mean?
Aaah! I can't believe you didn't even read the contract.
They gave me the gist of it!
Look, the Stealth Co. guy is right there. We'll just tell him to fix it.
Hey, dude. This isn't...what we...want-
What the-
Where is he?
Over here.
Is that a piece of cardboard?
Good eye, citizen.
Mmm-hmm. Yes, these are satisfying results.
As per our agreement, your house is no longer detectable by radar.
Yeah, or our eyes! Look, there was a misunderstanding. We don't want this!
Well, that's perfect. The test phase is over, and on order to protect our formula, we will be destroying the product.
As per our agreement, you will be reimbursed $500, minus jet-refueling fees, which adds up to..64 cents.
Jet-refueling fees?
Wait. When are you removing the paint?
Let's wrap it up, boys!
The jets will be here momentarily to destroy the house.
What?!
Well, well, how are you gonna blow up an invisible house, man?
With this tracking device.
Granny shot! I would retreat to a safe distance if I were you.
Smoke bomb. (echo)
Dude, we gotta get that tracking device.
Way ahead of ya!
Rigby, stop! We just have to get inside and get up there.
No, I got it!
Rigby!
I got it!
Dude, just do what I'm saying!
No! I can do it myself! I can be a solo bro!
What are you talking about?
We were supposed to do this together. Like we always do.
Then why did you say I could leave?
': Cause you got your whole "CJ" thing, and I wanted to help. It just kind of feels like we don't hang out like we used to.
Look, sometimes I'm gonna be doing other things. But you're my best friend. I'm not ditchin you, dude.
We're gonna die!
We gotta get inside the house!
Dude, it's the stairs!
It's the end of the hall!
That means the attic's right above us!
Where's the cord?
Got it!
What was that?
I don't know, Rigby. Maybe it's the broken attic ladder you said you'd fix last week.
Quit living in the past, man!
Come on. I'll boost you up.
I don't know my way around the attic!
Fine!
Now what?
The window's that way!
Watch out for the mirror! Left! Right! Turntable! Bird cage! Low-hanging beam! Mousetrap! Cobwebs! Close your mouth! Exposed wire! The window's in front of you!
Ah. This buttered popcorn is good.
Huh?
Hey! Get down from there! It's not safe!
Rigby, throw it!
Where?!
As far as you can, dude!
We did it!
Bros!
How much do you think I can get for this thing? $50? $60? How about this sweet pullover I found in the trash?
"Missile Tracking Device".
No, not back to us!
No, no, no, no!
No, no, no, no!
C'mon! Open!
Aaah! Why did I get extra butter? C'mon!!
Darn it!
Oh, man! Your car.
AND WHAT HAPPENED TO THE HOUSE?!!
Yeah, about that...
Yes! Fist Pump!
(laughs)
We have to go to that concert!
Seriously? Dude, they were cool in the third grade, but now...?
Correction, they're cool in any grade, but you wouldn't know that. Probably because you hate yourself or something!
Dude, we don't have the money for those tickets.
Doesn't even matter! We can figure out a way, but you're too busy figuring out a way to hate yourself!
Why do you wanna go so bad?
Going to this concert could be the biggest moment of my life...
Wow, sounds like your life sucks.
Shut up!
Hey, guys.
Hey, Margaret.
Were you guys talking about the concert?
Wait, you're going?
Yeah, I am! I know they're kinda old, but I remember them from when I was a kid. Besides, everyone is gonna be there. It's gonna be fun. You guys gonna go?
I'm totally gonna go.
Oh, so now you're gonn-
We'll be there.
Cool, see you guys there.
Yeah, see ya.
I can't believe you're going to a Fist Pump concert just for some lady pecs.
Rigby, one day you'll be old enough to understand the real reason that people go to concerts.
Whatever, it's to listen to music, I already know that. Now, how are we going to get the money for those tickets?
Dude, it's gonna be easy. We just have to work some extra hours.
Extra work? I don't even like regular work.
Do you like Fist Pump?
Yes.
Hmph, then you like extra work.
Hmph, fine.
Hmph, hmph.
Hmph, hmph.
Hmph, hmph, hmph, hmph, hmph, hmph, hmph, hmph...
Yes.
Aw, come on, Benson, please! Fist Pump is playing at Slammers and we don't have enough money for tickets!
Woo! That's right, ladies! We got two tickets to Fist Pump! See you later, grandmas!
Benson, you listen and you listen good.
Please Benson! Please give us overtime! Please!
What is the big deal? It's just some talentless band.
Actually, they aren't that bad, not that I'm into that stuff. We are pretty backed up though. I think you should give them the work.
Oh, I agree. I say if they want to see "Pump Fist", then let them see "Pump Fist"!
OOHHHH!!!
Here's a list of things we need done, when you finish them, you'll get your money.
OOOHHHH!!!
Dude, I'm fading fast.
Two for Fist Pump.
What?
But I thought they were 50!?
Aw, man!
No, no, no!
Mordecai, wait! Wait, man. We can't give up. Fist Pump!
I know, dude, but I just don't want to work anymo-oh my...
Maybe I could work a little more. Alright, dude. Let's do this.
You're lucky I care about lady pecs.
Benson, we need more money.
Yeah, give us more money.
There's no more chores left. Unless...you want to mow the lawn?
The lawn!?
Aw, what? That'll take forever!
Here's the keys. You know where the mower is.
Good luck.
Ohhhhhh...
Dude, seriously though, my eyes won't stay open anymore, and I think we're almost out of coffee.
Nonsense, dude. We got plenty of coffee.
Mordecai, what happened?
Need more coffee...need more Margaret...
Fist Pump...
Coffee?
"Greetings, fellow Fist Pump fans. May we help you get some tickets?"
What? Who are you?
"As you can see, I am a giant coffee bean. I can bring you caffeine. Do you accept?"
Wait, what?
Ah, cool, a contract! Let's sign it!
Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah!
Aw, man, I didn't know deluxe tickets were coated in diamonds.
So cool...
Where are the other two tickets?
Oh, jeez!
There's no 'other tickets', man. We only had enough for two.
But we had a contract!
Woo!!! Fist Pump!!!!
Woo, Fist Pump.
Dude, check it. Bang bang! Dude, I've got two if you want to take one to the concert.
Mordecai and Rigby, we are very excited for you to be the ones to see Fist Pump. Please accept this coffee to help you make it through concert.
Thanks!
Hey, what the...? This isn't...coffee!?
It's chamomile tea...the sleepiest of all teas...
....tickets.
Huh?
Hey!
Rigby, come on, they got the tickets! Come on, let's go, let's go!
Fist Pump!
Now what are we supposed to do?
Come on. I have an idea.
You morons! Get back here and help me pick up my gumballs!
Give us the tickets!
Uh, Mordecai and Rigby. Uh, funny seeing you here...
Why didn't you buy us tickets?
What are you talking about? We never said we'd buy you tickets!
But we had a contract!
Shut it!
You know, at first I thought you were cool. But now, I know that you're both total losers.
Everybody hates you.
Oh, and I just realized something.
What?
Your coffee sucks.
OOOHHHH!!!
Hey, dude.
Dude, there they are!
We did it! Fist Pump! Fist Pump!
I wonder where Margaret's sitting?
Aw, sick! It's all sweaty!
Woo!! I just threw my shirt! Bring out Fist Pump! Let's do it!
Hey, Mordecai!
Hey, Margaret! Fist Pump!
Mordecai! You have to meet my boyfriend, Slasher!
Hey, Slasher! That's my friend, Mordecai!
Don't be such a jerk!
Oh, this sucks.
Aw, don't worry about her, you'll get another chance.
(laughs) Woo!!
Dude, wake up! They're about to come out!
Wait. Must...stay awake. Must...see best band of all... time!
Aw, crap.
'Ello! We are Fist Pump! One, two, three, four!
Bad show...
That's a planet?
It looks like some weird appliance.
Ugh! Does everything have to try to kill us?
Reel-to-Reel?
Discmasters, it truly is a small universe to see you here. This is Black & White, sworn brother of the Format Wars.
But we need to get Pops to the Seer!
So, can you take us to her, or...?
Yeah. We can take you.
But first, he needs medical attention. Follow us.
Be kind, rewind.
Reel-to-Reel! What's the -
Frozen burritos! Get that guy in here, stat!
Come on, now, come on! Chew it!
Yes, chew it up. Come on! There you go! He's stable. After 50cc's of Salisbury Steak and a little rest, he'll be good as new!
You're a doctor?
Before the Format Wars. Before Streaming took over!
Took over?
I've got it all right here.
Now that you know the history, you understand why the old formats must put an end to this torrenting tyrant!
Why couldn't Streaming be stopped by this all-knowing Seer?
Everything's a gray area to you, Black & White.
They know the chosen one is here!
We've got to get to the Seer now!
What about Pops?
I'm alright!
Take me to the Seer.
Go! Run! I'll hold them off! I hope they're hungry...
Always follow proper heating instructions.
For the Formats!
Work perks!
It's okay, HD. They're with us.
The chosen one.
And it's the five Discmasters as well!
DVD? You're here too?
No. DVD is dead.
What?
Whatever, I still have better sound definition than you!
Tell that to my ten gigs of extra storage.
I would, but I think someone's surface coding is a little too thick to understand!
Well at least I'm not the one with the ability to roam any region, and still went crying home to daddy!
You leave father out of this!
Whoa, whoa, kids! Don't scratch a disc! We need to get Pops to the Seer.
Right, sorry. Follow us.
Allow me, my bitrate is faster.
Your face is a bitrate.
Seer! We have brought the chosen one.
Ah yes, Pops. I've been expecting you.
You know who I am?
Of course I do. I know each and every one of you.
You don't know me!
Oh, Muscle Man. Always so brash. You know who else is always so brash?
Uhh, who?
Come on...you know.
I don't know what you're talking about, lady!
My...mom...
Whoa, bro.
That's right! I've been watching you guys since the very beginning. I know everything about you.
Everything?
Sure. You all work at the Park, you and Rigby are the slacker duo, Benson's the grouchy manager, Skips is immortal. Funny stuff!
Psht! Anyone could have known that!
Oh yeah?
You started off really strong.
But when Mordecai started dating Margaret, things levelled off a little.
I was always more of a CJ fan myself.
Every Halloween was a spiking interest, but lately that's been a little weak as well.

Rigby going to high school helped! As did Muscle Man getting married. Everybody sure loves weddings. And the whole going to space thing? Whoo! I was not expecting that. I'm curious to see where things go now. But then again -
Everything must end eventually.
End? What will end?

Your universe, of course! Many universes have come and gone, it's the natural order of things. Yours lasted longer than most, but now the universe, your lives, the Park...everything. It's going to end.
It can't end!
Ah, but this is what this has all been leading up to, Pops.
The final battle with your evil twin.
We can't hold Streaming much longer!
We gotta get Pops out of here!
Not today, you dumb data boxes!
You cash hungry content coffins!
How are you so calm? The universe is ending!
It's not my universe that's ending, it's yours. It's a shame that I won't be able to watch it anymore. I've really grown quite fond of you all. Personally, I wish you had a bigger role, dear.
Ugh, it's like an oversaturation of the marketplace.
Time to cancel our subscription!
We're almost there!
Hahahahaha!
Streaming?!
Hello HD DVD and Blu-ray! And you've brought all your remaining formats to me. Finally, I can add you all to my queue OF DESTRUCTION!
NO!
Black & White, no! You can't stop him!
Fool, there's no escape. Streaming is the future!
You can make it, Black & White. There's still a market for you!
Quick, while he's still buffering!
Go, go!
Now you must go to where it all began, Pops. To your home planet, Lolliland, that's where the final battle will take place.
Do I really have to fight my brother?
You've fought him before, and you will fight him again, and your universe will reset itself. That's how it's always been and how it will always be.
There must be another way!
Hmm, sometimes doing something different makes all the difference! But then again, everybody loves re-runs!
Oh, no!
Go now, Pops. Make it a jolly good show.
Eileen, enter the coordinates!
You got it!
My...favorite planet.
WHAT DO YOU THINK YOU'RE DOING?!
Uh...
How many times do I have to explain what "authorized personnel only" means? Are you authorized personnel, boys? Are you?!
No, sir. Sorry, sir.
Now get down and give me fifty!
-is what I would've said if you hadn't gotten the highest score in Space Race Deluxe I've ever seen!
You mean that video game?
Okay.
Why are we here?
Uh, you're the pit crew.
How are we gonna be the pit crew? This is crazy! Are we gonna get trained?
Ha, ha! You think I hadn't thought of that?
Meet Hans and Lars. They're our best racers, or at least they were, until you guys beat their high score in the racing simulator!

Hey, Skips. Can I borrow your car for prom?
No.
Rigby, you know I don't I have a car.
Augh! You mean I just gave you sugar for nothing?
Hey, hey. Hey, hold up. There's still someone you could ask.
Bro...
No!
Bro...
NO!!
Bro...
Would you two pipe down?! I'm trying to polish my picture of my prized car!
"Drop in". Ha! You really think Rigby would just come to dinner? I know you just need something.
That's our Donny!
I ate at Cheezer's yesterday.
That was a good update, Don.
Yeah, and?
Oh ho ho! There it is! Now, it comes out! See, Barbara? Of course he needs something! No, you cannot borrow my prized 1964 Luxury Sedan!
Augh! This is so typical! You care more about that dumb car than you care about me!
THAT'S IT, GO TO YOUR ROOM!!!
So, Don, you ready for some dessert?
I know.
I'm not crying.
Thanks, Mom.
I will, Mom.
My dad. Pretty cool, right?
Wow, that was nice of him. Let's go crazy like teens!
Hmm?
Now, be careful.
Come on, let's have fun!
Yeah, Jablonski?
A bunch of us are gonna go hang out at Lookout Mountain. See you there.
Cool.
The car. Oh, right.
Are you okay? It looks like you're stewing. Rigby, please tell me what are you stewing about?
My dad didn't loan me the car.
What? You didn't steal it, did you?
I know how you feel. My mom can get pushy, too, but she still cares. I'm sure your dad cares, too. There's no way this is more important to him than your happiness.
I'M HIS FATHER!!!!
Rigby was here? Augh! I gave him all his credits and I still can't get rid of him!
So, do you like prom?
Oh, please be careful. This is my dad's suit. He cherishes it, but he let me borrow it just for tonight because he really really loves me.
You're not making any sense! Where's my son?!
Take me there!
Why, yes, Tony, I do.
Dad! What are you doing here?!
I'm taking back my stolen car from my no-good son!
Uh, good luck, man.
What?!
You heard me!
Look out!
Oh, no! Oh, no! Oh, no! AAHH!!!
Rigby!
Oh, no, this is really high!
Dad, are you serious right now? Dad, I do stuff like this all the time. Just let me help!
No, it's my car, you'll crash it!
Eileen, you, too?
NOOOOO!!!!!
AAH! Go left, go left! AAH! Not right! AAH!
Forget about the car. Are you okay?
Um, yeah.
Eileen, you okay?
Eileen, did you have a good time?
We did it, dude! We mowed the entire lawn with out taking a single break! You wanna go get some lunch?
Dude, what happened to you?
Chrissy happened, man, she dumped me, and she'll probably never talk to me again.
That's rough, man. What went wrong?
Wooooaaaaahhhh...
Uh, don't worry, dude, we'll help you get your girlfriend back.
You will?
It's easy, you just gotta get something nice to show her you care about her.
Yeah, man, the mall has like 20 stores that only sells stuff for guys who need to apologize to their girlfriends. With our help, you'll be back in the saddle in no time.
Dude, saddle jokes, not cool.
Eh, you only ruined like seven stores with your partying.
Good luck, man. Let us know how it goes.
Oh, you know I will!
Chrissy's gonna love those presents.
Yeah, you can't go wrong with jewelry, flowers and chocolate, every guy knows that.
Benson's gonna be really mad about this hole.
I'll get the shovels.
And done.
But every guy knows you can't go wrong with jewelry, flowers and chocolate.

I repeat, the presents were a major fail. She said that stuff is what guys think girls want and all those presents did was prove I was thinking about some generic idea of a girl, and not her specifically.
Woah...
That's so complicated.
After Chrissy negged on your prezzos, I panicked and made her a mix-tape of dope party jams called "Bass in Your Face", and for some reason, that was a bust, too.
But that sounds like a really good mix.
Uh-nuh, duh! Augh!
Sorry, buddy. I guess we need a female prospective if we're gotta crack this nut you call Chrissy.
So let me get this straight, you're a Party Horse from another planet and you need our help to get your girlfriend back.
Yes.
Have you've tried talking to her, just being real?
Um, let's try some role playing, maybe?
Okay.
Margaret, you be Chrissy, Party Horse, you be you, and go.
Don't do me like this, Chrissy, we're a perfect match! With that body and these abbs, we're the hottest couple on Party Horse Planet.
Hmm, well, she dedicates herself to her interest, I think that's cool, and I like that she's in to art.
Good, this is good.
And I guess there's the way she elevates my very being and makes me wanna be a better person.
Party Horse, that was perfect. Call Chrissy and tell her exactly what you just said.
Party Horse, I'm sorry, but...
That's actually a really nice idea.
It is?
That guy really doesn't like you, huh?
Aw, yeah! You gotta party so crazy you never wanna party again.
So we'll see you guys later.
So these pods really don't have a way to land safely?
Wow, you're so well-prepared when it comes to parties.
Oh, this is just the local news paper. I actually have terrible spatial skills, so let's just start here.
WHOOOOOOO!!!!!!!
Ha ha ha ha ha! That was awesome!
Yeah.
(yawns)
Did you get the party out of you yet, Party Horse?
Aww, I still wanna party! Have we done all of the houses yet?
Chrissy's house!
What?

I did some thinking after our last chat, and I realized I was wrong. All this I've been trying to teach you about knowledge and responsibility when I should've been letting you party. I guess what I'm trying to say is party on, Party Horse, party on.
Wow! Thanks, Principal Party Horse.
Why not?
Dudes, I am so confused.
Go for it, man. Maybe, this is the last bit of partying you need to get the party out of your system for good.
The reverse psychology worked perfectly! I've finally trapped Party Horse!
So, wait, hold on, I'm sorry, is there, like, not a really cool party in this box?
STOP!!!! Dad, stop it!
No, Chrissy, if this is what will stop me from partying, then I'll do it for you.
But...
He said he'll do it!
I... like eating sandwiches and... fantasy football.
Eugh!
Uh, what?
Well done, Principal Party Horse, sir. It this what you wanted, Chrissy?
No! I've been trying to tell you all along, but you never even chilled out long enough to listen to me! I just wanted you to take it down a notch.
That's all? Well, I can do that.
Party Horse is back in business!
WOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!
(groans)
I'm good.
That's alright.
Yes, yes. Thank you, and welcome to the annual Parkie Awards. Now, we have a truly staggering, even grueling number of awards to hand out tonight.
So let's jump right into the fun, huh?
Our first award is for best raking...
The award for cleanest pond goes to...
The park with the most well-behaved children is...
Okay, halfway done, folks. And for most uniform lawn...
Best birthday spots...
For healthiest trees...
Let's give it up to Harrison Lake Park for most fertile land. How do they do it?
We've been here for four hours!
What are you doing? You're acting like children! I'm up for Park Manager of the Year, this is the big leagues. Gene usually sweeps the awards, but I know for a fact that I have a chance this year.
I mean, after that embarrassing fertilizer fiasco East Pines had?
Well, this seems like as good a time as any that we remember the fallen. Our park manager brethren, none of whom had won an award, but will still be missed despite their lack of excellence.
And now, a moment of silence.
I'd like to thank Wing Kingdom for sponsoring this event! Before you get your angel wings, come by and get some spicy ones!
And now the award we've all been waiting for...the Park Manager of the Year Award! The nominees are...
What!? That's not the picture I told you to send!
But don't you want them to know the real you, Benson?
Yeah, it's honest!
And the Parkie goes to...
Shh! This is it!
Ben...
...jamin Smith! He's another guy who died. That's food for thought. Anyway, get up here, Gene! You won!
The best of the best certainly won tonight, huh, folks? Another big thanks to Wing Kingdom, and we'll see you next year at the annual Parkie Awards!
Okay, so I didn't win. It's an honor to even be nominated.
Judged by a jury of my peers. With peers like these, who needs friends!?
Hey, uh, why don't you go get some fresh air?
I'm gonna get some fresh air!
Jokers wouldn't know a good park from a hole in the park.
Benson took that pretty hard.
Yikes. I'm embarrassed for him.
Man, Benson's ten times the park manager Gene is.
Look, he doesn't even care that he won.
Ha! They give awards for anything these days. I floss twice a day, nominate me for that!
Hot wings, sir?
Definitely!
There's just no justice in the world.
Let's grab Benson and get out of here.
Hey Benson, how about we have a guys' night out, how's that sound?
Yeah! We could do it up! We'd just need some wings, some slo-mo explosions, a sweet ride...
That stuff's for winners. Winners like Gene. He's probably out having the time of his life.
Huh?
What the?
Oh, my!
Rigby, what are you thinking!?
What better way to feel like a winner than with a real award? Besides, he didn't even miss it.
It's the principal of the thing!
What, is it because it doesn't have your name on it?
Here, I'll fix it.
No! We have to call Gene now! We'll tell him we have his award and it's a misunderstanding.
Gene, it's Benson. Call me back, it's important.
I got the machine.

Man, guys. What a night! I really just don't know what to say! Well, heh. I know what I would've said if I'd won. It was a show-stopper speech. I had to edit down three paragraphs I'd written about this guy.
And you were in it, and you were in it!

WHOOOHHHH!!
Well, not in the original, but I added you in after how much fun we just had.
Hmph, hmph. Hmph, hmph.
Maybe it's not too late bro.
Mega-cool of you to let us in like this, man.
Sorry, sorry, I'll start.
Fives?
It's not me. I just turned on the lights.
Huh?
What the?
Hey, what do you think you're doing, mate?
I'm...giving my speech? I'm just trying to have my moment.
You've got plenty of moments!
Give me that mic!
That's it!
Child coming through!
Hey!

Look at yourselves! What are we doing? We all just want the same thing: to be appreciated. So why are we fighting? We've all given speeches to ourselves, in the shower, in the car, so let's give them to each other...right here, right now, together.
And me and my mates were in the outback, down by the opera house, when this crocodile comes flying out of nowhere! Well, I got that croc in a headlock and punched him in the stomach!
That's the end of my story.
Thank you. Boomerang.

Thank you! Thank you! It's a great honor to have received this award.

Uh, I'd like to thank Pops, Skips, Mordecai, Muscle Man, Hi Five Ghost -

Too bad there's no trophy for it.
Got your message, thought I'd find you here.
Oh, right.
This belongs to you. Sorry to worry you.

What?

See you at the next lodge meeting!
And the Parkie goes to...Benson, from Park!
Come to the stage and claim your prize!
Here you go, Benson. You deserve it.

This is really the best award I could win. I'd like to thank all of you guys, not just for being the best staff I've worked with, but also being the best friends I could ask for. Because of you, every day I come into work, I feel like a true winner. Thank you.
Well, this way is totally faster.
Yeah, cuts the time in half.
Yeah, but the hose.
(off-screen) Well, at least it's diet. Nobody drinks that.
Okay, men, this is the hour of our prominence. On my signal, charge! Whooaaa...
Awwooohhh, somebody's busted!
Oh, grow up.
Did you lose the colonel again? Try under your hat.
What else is new? Don't worry, Pops. I'll take care of it.
Then we understand each other?
Absolutely. I've already warned them—one more screw up, and they're both fired.
I'd like you to stop yelling at Mordecai and Rigby.
(Scoffs) You're kidding.
Quite the opposite. It's too negative and bad for morale.
What morale? Those slackers never do anything unless you yell at them.
There's never a reason to yell at anyone.
They give me a million reasons everyday. Pfft, you just want me to be nice to them?
You don't have to be nice—just don't yell.
Yes, but--
And that means you must do what I say?
Technically, but I--
And I am ordering you to stop yelling at Mordecai and Rigby.
Pops--
...Understood.
So what did Pops want?
What? You told us to take it nice and easy.
Yeah, I get it now. It takes time to do things right.
You rush, you make mistakes.
Yeah and like, what is a hose? Hose...
Hose...
Hose...?
Benson, what did we just discuss?

Hey, Benson. Have you seen the keys to the cart?
Omm. Omm. Omm. Omm. Omm. Omm. Omm.
Never mind. I think I know where they are.
Raaaargh!

You know what happens next, don't you? (Hands Benson the paper angrily)

Dude, what's he doing?

Pass the salt, please.
Benson, uh, look, we're sorry, man.
No...
I'm not gonna yell.
Aw, yeah-yuh!
Sweet!
I'm not... gonna... yell...
What happened?

He's holding all of his anger in.
Why would he do that?!
I told him that if he didn't stop yelling at you two, I would fire him.
Pops, you can't do that.
Not a problem. Hey, Benson! You're a sorry excuse for a manager!
Yeah, you nasal-voiced, loser-loner!
Go back to night school and learn how to have a personality!
And guess what! We're the ones who keep sending pizzas to your apartment!
Benson, I need you to yell at Mordecai and Rigby!
But if I yell, you'll fire me.
Benson! Benson, are you alright?
What?
Yeah! I knew you were going to win when you came out of that gum wrapper.
Nice work, Eiloin!
Don't worry about it Eileen. I'll drop it off at your place for ya.
Really?
Yeah, of course!
Wow, thanks Rigby! I gotta run, see you guys later!
Bye!
Later!
Give me a hand with this, will ya Mordecai?
Well, I'm not actually gonna drop it off.
We can watch some flat-screen, maybe get some pizza. It'll be awesome!
That might be the nicest thing you've ever done.
Like you said, she worked hard for this. Be careful, Mordecai, there's a step behind you.
OK. That's enough, dude. You're freaking me out.
You know where Eileen keeps her house key?
Yeah, I water her plants sometimes when she goes out of town for a dance invitational or whatever.
Who's Joanne?
Wait, Rigby, don't!....Not here.
Aahh....ooh...
Joanne! I thought you were at the beach!
No.
Look Joanne, I didn't-
What happened? Where'd she go?
We were wrong to touch your T.V., okay? Haven't you ever made a mistake before?
Whoa, Rigby!
Nice whip action!
Wait, is your last name Hanatronic?
ENOUGH! Why is our priceless family television sitting at the bottom of this river?!
Wait, what just happened here?!
What's gonna happen to her?
Now I get why she didn't want you touching her stuff.
What's going on?
It was all Rigby's idea.
(blushes) Really?
And as an added bonus, Joanne is not your roommate anymore!
AAAHH! The local news! This is the best surprise ever!
Well, we wanted to order a pizza and have it ready for you when you got here, but we didn't plan ahead.
Thanks, Mordecai!....Now, can I borrow some money for the pizza guy?
Pffftt. I guess things are back to normal.
Thanks, Phil. It's good to be back in town!
Bros!? There's 8 hungry people living here! Did you seriously just split that "O" once?

line: I'm glad you could all join me for brunch today.

Hey, so can I pay with this?
Oh, of course, but I don't think we have enough money in the register to make change. Will you take a check?
Sure!
Come on! (laughs)
I'm telling ya, I can't lose! (gets up and walks away)
I gotta go dry off. (gets up and goes to the bathroom) Aw what, they're all out of towels?
It must be your lucky day sir, the 1000th customer gets a free meal.
All right!

Oh, we're reading fortunes eh? Okay, lets see what we have here, probably gonna win the lottery or something. Bad luck is coming your way? Ha! Whatever, it will take more than just a slip of paper to break the winning streak I'm having. Come on, let's get out of here.
Rigby, seriously. You need to switch those fortunes back.
(slaps Mordecai's hand away) Oh, come on! Benson's been having crazy good luck lately. He won't even know the difference. (walks away from the table) Besides, it's just a piece of paper.
(walks away as well) Yeah.. I guess.
You know what would make that place better? Some fortunes that were actually true.
Dude, Benson, you okay?
Yeah, I'm alright.
(picks up a gold coin) Alright! It's a bus token!
Come on guys. The bus is here.
That's cool guys! I guess I'll just walk!
Oooooh! High score up in here! Mordecai, are you seeing this? I'm so lucky I don't even need to look at the screen! In fact, I don't even need to use my hands! Check it!
Ugh, I don't believe this.
OOOOHH! Did you see that? I'm gonna be on the cover of Video Game Monthly!
Dude, you're horrible at video games! You just got lucky.
Exaactlyy! I should have switched fortunes with Benson years ago!
None of that good luck is yours. It belongs to Benson. All this good stuff should be happening to him.
What? No way! My life's never been better! I'm on a serious winning streak!
Give it back! (pushes Rigby to the floor and does a pat search on him)
What are you doing? Hey, get off me!
Give me the fortune!
No!
I'm not gonna let you ruin Benson's life. Ugh! (lets go of Rigby and Rigby stands up) Where is it?
It's not on me. I knew you'd try something so I hid it.
Dude, you have to trade it back. Bad things are happening to Benson and it's only gonna get worse!
What are you talking about? I haven't seen a single bad thing happen to Benson. You know what I think? I think you're just jealous.
Jealous?
Jealous!
Dude, seriously-
JEALOUS!
Rigby!
JEALOUS OF MY LUCK!
I'm calling Benson.
(jokingly) Oh no, don't call Benson.
Oooooh!
Ugh, forget it. (walks away) I'm telling him.
Whatever. I'm so lucky I bet he wouldn't even notice. Hm hm hm hm hm!
Hey, have you seen the guy who use to live here?
Did he say where he was going?
I haven't seen him.
Skips, have you seen Benson?
He's playin' cards in my garage. He's convinced he can turn his luck around
No, he can't. It's not even his luck. We have to stop him.
Benson, I gotta tell you something.
Not right now, Mordecai. I'm in the middle of a hand.
No, Benson, listen. You shouldn't be playing cards right now.

Okay, so I've had a bad stretch lately. So my wallet and credit cards got stolen. So accounting lost my paycheck. So I can't afford to pay my rent or feed myself. But cards are where I'm luckiest. Cards are my girl. She's never let me down before and she won't do it this time.
Well you gotta stop playin' now cos you got nothin' left to wager with.
Actually, Skips, there is one more thing. (Benson walks back into Skips' garage and walks back into the room again). I just lost the park to the guy in the fanny pack.
He's a Warlock.
Wooh, what the?
The park! What have I done?
I gotta find Rigby.
Park! Warlock! Fanny pack!
What was that bro? (screams in terror and jumps into a bush which gets sucked in)
Rigby!
(holding a mobile phone) Uh uh uh! Interview. Video Game Monthly. Can't talk. You're a loser.
Ugh! (snatches phone off Rigby)
Hey!
Dude! Why did you do that?!
Look out the window!
(looks out the window) Huh?
Come on!
What's going on??
Don't you get it? It's the fortunes! Benson's luck is getting so bad it's gonna destroy everything, look!
Benson! Take my hand!
Nooooo!
Aw, man! (Benson gets sucked in) Okay, okay, I'll switch back!
Where's the fortune?
It's under my trampoline!
Oh man. How are we supposed to get over there?
Give me the keys.
Almost there!
Benson! We gotta trade fortunes!
Why bother? Another bad thing is just gonna happen.
No Benson! All these bad things are happening because of me! I switched fortunes behind your back at the Chinese restaurant!
You what?
I was jealous of all the good luck you've been having so I gave you all my bad luck! I'm sorry.
Is it over?
I think so..
Ah, good.
(to Rigby) OVER?! Nothing's over! You switched my fortune! Do you have any idea what I went through?!
Alright alright, I'm sorry! At least I confessed, that's gotta count for something (the broken mobile phone rings and Rigby picks it up). Hello?
Aw, what?
Woooo! Wooo! You know who else is hot and tears through stuff? MY MOM!
I'm telling ya, I can't lose! (gets up and walks away)
I gotta go dry off (gets up and walks away)
Finally my fortune cookie's here! At least one good thing will come from this meal.
We now return to... "Fool Me Once, Shame on You. Fool Me Twice, I Punch Your Face!"
Whoo! Yeah!
And now here's Shinehara!
WH-O-O-O-OA!
What is this?
Japanese game show.
ROUND 2!
Now, Clive, try to fool me again.
Oh! Announcerbot, please, fetch toothpick.
You! Fool! Me! Twice!
Dude, he's a goner. Nobody's ever completed the "Baka Blitz."
What do you think the Mystery Prize is? I heard it's a billion yen, which is like a million dollars!
I heard it's an 800-pound tuna. You could buy a house with that in Japan.
You know what I heard? This show is GARBAGE!
Clive, ready?
Go!
Go! Go! Go! C'mon! Yeah!
Ha ha ha! Hahahahaha!
': Cause it's funny. You're a wet blanket, man.
No, I'm not!
Not on the park phones you're not.
But it says land lines only!
That's a long-distance call.
We could win the Mystery Prize.
Hm-hm!
What's up, man?

line: That looks awesome.
Ooh, I kind of already got 2 tickets for Pajama Sisters 2.
What? Why? That's just some chick flick. And not even the good kind! I saw the preview. They're just gonna sit around talking about their feelings, fully clothed.
Aw, what? But it's opening night! Do you know how hard it was to get these tickets?
Hey, guys, your food is almost ready. Sorry for the hold-up.
Oh, hey, Margaret. Um, I was wondering, uh, would you, uh, like to, uh, you know, uh...
You're gonna have to excuse Mordecai here. He has a hard time trying to "espresso" himself.
Dude, did you see how hard Margaret laughed at me?
That wasn't funny.
Yes it was. Man, what's your problem?
Salad? Where's my French dip?
Huh? Oh, I'm sorry. I messed up, let me take it back.
Everything okay, Margaret? You seem like you've got a "full plate".
I can help you.
Really? Thanks, Mordecai!
Hey, Margaret, I can help you move too.
Oh, perfect! Do you guys mind coming by my place in an hour?
Oh, we don't mind. It'll be a "moving" experience for all of us.
Ow! What?
Nothing.
Wait a minute... you're jealous.
What? No I'm not.
Dude, you're just jealous 'cause I made her laugh and all you do is sit like this: Uh, uh, uh...
Whatever. Just stay out of my way when I'm helping her move.
Alright, guys, we're almost done.
Do it. Just do it. Hey, Margaret. Um, I've been meaning to ask you, uh, do you want to, uh, have me pick up that box?
Hey, Rigby. You better leave, dude. You're ruining my chances with Margaret.
What? You haven't even made a move on her yet. You're gonna end up seeing Zombie Dinner Party with me anyway.
No, I'm not. Quit screwing this up for me.
You're just jealous that I can talk to chicks, and you can't!
You gonna ask her out or what?
Hey, guys. Ready to call it a day?
Margaret! Uh, just wanted to ask you if you want to, uh, I mean you obviously don't have to but, uh...
You actually got tickets? Yeah, I'll totally go with you tonight! Mordecai, you gotta come too!
Mordecai can't come because I only got two tickets!
Aw, maybe next time?
No. No, it's cool. You guys have a good time.
Alright, dude, I'll go to the movie with you. Just call it off with her.
Pfft, yeah, right. I'm not going with you. You had your chance, and you blew it! You blew it!
Agh! Come on, dude, just give me another chance.
Ok, I give you another chance, if you admit that you're jealous.
No, I'm not jealous.
Then I guess I'm still going out with Margaret. Ohhhhhhhhh! You blew it again, you blew it again!
Mordecai, check this out.
What?
Ohhhh!
Ohhhhhh! 2 more hours till my date.
I'm warning you man. You better call her and cancel.
It could be twenty minutes till your date. Or maybe it's half an hour, or maybe you already missed it!
Whatever! I'll find out what time it is!
Call it off with her.
You're jealous, Mordecai! It's all over your face!
Dude, what are you doing? You can't do that!
(jumps on Mordecai) Gimme back those clocks!
No!!
What's your problem?! Why do you have to be jealous all the time?!
Shut up! This is all your fault! I finally get a chance to ask out Margaret, but you had to butt in and ruin everything!
(enraged) I'LL KILL YOU!!!
Who are you?
I am Father Time. And you're the one who's been running around microwaving all my clocks.
I didn't mean too.
I know, I'm sorry. Can you bring him back?
No. His body has been blown to bits of star-stuff. And now, you get to spend eternity here at the end of time. All because of your petty jealousy.
I'm not jealous.
Yes, you are!
No, I'm not!
You better be. Now, I'll give you a do-over just this once.
Aww, man. Thanks so much.
But remember, stop bottling up your emotions, because if I ever get you back here again, you'll be sorry. Now, get on the Time Pony.
Time Pony?
What?
That's just weird. Now get out of my dimension.
Rigby! You're-you're here!
Shhh! We're watching the trailer.
Zombie Dinner Party.
That looks awesome.
Hey, guys, your food's almost ready, sorry for the hold-up.
You're gonna have to excuse Mordecai here. He has a hard time trying to "espresso" himself.
Dude, I'm not-- Well, maybe just a little bit.
Alright. Because Pops thinks you're ready for more responsibility, he wants me to give you more important jobs. So I'm gonna start by having you get the donuts for the morning meeting.
Whoa, really?
Yes. But first, some ground rules. One, pick me up a whole wheat donut.
A whole wheat donut? You mean a bagel?
Yeah, no problem.
Good. Now what did I just say?
Get the donuts and don't pass them out or we're fired.
And?
Oh, and you want a whole wheat donut.
Awww-yeaaayuhhh, boy, let's pick some donuuuuutss!
Wait, dude, remember what Benson said? We'd like one whole wheat donut please.
Alright. Now we can pick what we want.
Let's get two of those! And five of those, and some of those!
We'll take them!
We'll give you ten bucks.
Donuts delivered!
Dude, that job was so easy, we got it done in no time!
YEAH, WE DID!
Only if you feel like losing.
That's two out of three! I only lost the first one because I was thirsty!
Pfft. Whatever, you're always thirsty.
Ahh! Pops, did you eat an apple fritter?
Why, yes, yes, I did eat an apple fritter.
Benson told us not to let anyone touch those!
Oh, my, I hope I haven't caused you any trouble!
Don't sweat it, Pops.
Here. Problem solved. Benson will never know that Pops ate one.
Let's get him out of here before Benson sees.
Dude, it's no use, he won't hold still!
Pops, chill.
Dude, the meeting starts in fifteen minutes! How are we going to calm him down before it starts?!
We have to tire him out.
Dude, this isn't working! We've only got a couple of minutes until the meeting starts and he is still super hyper!
We've gotta take him to Skips.
Yeah, I've seen this happen to him before. He'll crash if we just give him more sugar.
Have I ever been wrong?
Hmm...better give him some more.
(He slowly opens up the box again.)
(Dunks whole head into the box, eating up the donuts)
Uh-oh.
What? Why "Uh-oh"? He is coming back, right?
Uh... probably not.
Grab a donut. We're going in after him.
Oh, hooray! You're all here!
Pops! You're back to normal!
Not yet. Look around.
What's going on?
We're on a higher sugar plane. They appear to be moving slow because we're moving so fast. We still need more sugar before we can crash.
That's it! Pops' money! That should have enough sugar.
It's the only way to get back to normal, Pops. We HAVE to.
Oh...alright.
You guys go ahead. I'll figure a way back.
But, Skips-
No time to argue! The meeting's gonna start in any minute!
You heard the man!
(He reluctantly eats a lollipop and he is transported also.)
Uh-oh.
What the-
Look, it's Skips! (the three walk up to him)
Skips! Skips, are you-
There he is. Pops, you okay?
(He is Scared, points at the very slow motioned park people.)
(He makes a bunch of low, slow growling sounds.)
Dude, this is all wrong.
Why isn't this working?!
I wanna go home!!!
Don't worry, Pops, we'll figure something out.
Dude, I think I have an idea!
Alright. That scares me.
No, dude! Seriously, if more sugar doesn't make us crash, then we need the opposite of sugar!
Like what?
(Slowly waves his shirt around, confirming that this was the sugar plane they were looking for.)
Dude, it worked!
Dude, Skips, you were wrong! The whole wheat donut was what we needed all along, not more sugar!
Ooooooooh! In your face, Skips! You were WRONG!
Gee, well, I'm sorry I-
WRONG, I SAY!! YOU WERE WRONGFULLY WRONG!!
Yeah, yeah. Alright, let's go back to normal.
Uh, what did he say?
Oh, it sounded like a gown of meat!
No, he is going to the meeting! It's about to start! To the house, quick!
We're gonna make it!
Rigby! Put the donuts down!
Ahh! There aren't any donuts left!
Benson's not gonna like that.
No, he's not. We have to go back to the donut shop.
They're in!
Everyone eat the rest of the whole wheat donut!
Oh...my head.
No more sugar.
Looks like he's at it again.
Ugh... Why does he waste his time?
You've been building your water slide for six weeks.
You're never gonna ride it, man.
Dude, dude, we dare you to ride it right now.
Dude, its totally sturdy.
Yeah, but-
What? You think just cause you're yelling "Boo" I'm gonna ignore-
Booooo!
Hmm, hmm, hmm hmm!
Sure you are, man!
You think he's really gonna do it?
No dude, he's never gonna do it. He'll just wuss out like he did last week.
Yep, any second now he'll stop.
Yeah!
Go dude!
Go man!!
Oh, geez!
Yah, aaah! Yah!
Are you okay?
Ahh!
What do you mean you can't babysit tonight? I know it's short notice. I'll pay you double. Wait, wait, don't hang up!! Oh!
I'm in a bit of a rush today, so I'll just take Muscle Man's soul and be off.
But I'm barely even hurt. It's just a few broken--
No wait, stop!
Sorry, boys. No exceptions.
Please, we'll do anything!
Anything?
Yeah!
Yeah.
Hmm, wait a sec. Maybe we can make a deal. If you two babysit my son Thomas so I can take my wife out for our anniversary tonight, I'll let your friend go.
Sure, not a problem.
Very good.
Oh, no! Help me, bros!
I'll be keeping your friend in this amulet until the wife and I return from dinner. And one more thing: if Thomas isn't asleep by 8:00, Muscle Man's soul is mine for eternity. Got it?
Baby! I'm home!
And how did my husband contact you a month ago?
Phone.
Email.
Fax.
Email?
Phone?
Fax?
All three naturally. Wanted to be thorough.
And you've had experience with paranormal children?
Yeah. Pairs, one on one, all sorts of normal kids.
Hey, so, where is the little guy anyway?
Oi, Thomas. Say hi to uncle Mordo and uncle Rigs.
So, where is the reservation?
Oh, you know, that extra fancy, extra available place.
I can't believe this! You losers better know what you're doing! Do you even know how to get a kid to sleep?
Dude, no problem.
Yeah, man, he's just a kid,
Okay little dude, time to go to sleep.
What the--
Wait, you can talk?
Of course I can. I am over 300 years old.
Wait, do your parents know?
NO! And let's keep it that way! I wanna ride this baby thing out for a little while longer, and before I slumber, I demand that we play.
That was an excellent playtime.
Ok! Now, you need to go to sleep!
Hello?
They're on their way home.
What do we do?!
You get up there and put that kid to bed, or I'll haunt you turds for the rest of your lives!
Thomas?
Thomas!
Thomas, get down from there!
You promised you'd go to bed after you ate!
I'm not sure that's a good idea.
He searched far and wide for souls to eat, but only got hungrier.
Uh...
PULL IT! This is my favorite part!
What's the point? The book's over, dude.
Don't be afraid, just feed it!
What do we feed it?
Souls. (He tries to teleport Muscle Man out of the amulet.)
Wah!
Mordecai! Catch!
Dude, we have to get the worm back in the book!
Rigby!
Mordecai, throw Muscle Man over to Thomas!
Trust me!
You better not do it, man!
Sorry, Muscle Man!
Ah! That's not what I meant!
Dude. Nice!
Ugh. I think I'm gonna hurl.
I could have been killed! I'm never going to sleep! Never, ever! Look at the time!
Uhhhhh....
Bring Muscle Man back.
Alright, fine. A deal's a deal.
Wait, how do we get home?
Man last night was the best. The best.
(while tapping on the keys of Mordecai's phone): Yeah, it was pretty fun.
I mean, Margaret and Eileen over for "Game Night", and nothing went wrong. No space portals, no video demons, nobody got hurt.
Except for Eileen and I whipping your butts.
Ok, just a sec. I'm making you a new custom wallpaper.
All right, I'm going to take this stuff to dump.
Heh. You mean you're going take that trash to your face.
... and gimme my phone.
You're lucky I'm in a good mood from last night.
Hmm hmm. Hmm!

Doo doo doo! A-hanging with Margaret just-a feels so good like I knew it would. Laughing together and-a having a blast. And I hope it lasts forever. I can't believe how hot she is. Makes my insides feel like knotted twists. Her pretty face and those long, long legs, and I hope someday we are more than just friends! (long pause). Oh, Margaret. Oh Margaret! I love it when you stand or sit right next to me. Can't you see? Your future with me is brighter than the ocean... What? "Brighter than the ocean?"
Huh?
No! No! No! Delete! delete! Delete!
Oh, my...
Rigby! Dude, its over! She's never gonna talk to me again!
Who?
Margaret! I was singing about her in the cart, and it recorded it to her voicemail!
Why did you call her in the first place?
I sat on my phone. It was an accident!
You butt dialed her?
She must think I'm a total loser!
Come on! It can't be THAT bad!
(still with his eyes covered with his hands): I sang a song about how hot she was, and how I wanted us to be together forever.
Dude, no! That'll make it even worse!
Hi, this is Margaret.
I'm at work right now, so leave a message after the beep.
She's still at work.
Which means she hasn't checked her voicemail yet!
Dude... we have to get to her phone and erase that message.
Okay, there she is.
*gasp* Oh no!
Oooooh! Burned! She saw that you left a message, and didn't even CHECK it! That's cold, man.
Margaret!
Oh, hey Mordecai! How's it going?
Oh, you know. Good.
Goooooood...
Hey, I had a really fun time last night.
Oh yeah, yeah. Yeah yeah yeah! Me too!
Yeah, I thought we made a good team, you and me.
Uh huh?
There was a bug!
What?!
I got it!
Rigby! Where did you-
Oh no! My phone!
Wait, YOUR phone?!
Yeah, Eileen told me to watch for calls while she was in the bathroom.
(to Eileen): Oh, here.
Gee, thanks...
Wait, so, can I borrow YOUR phone then?
Oh, I don't know where I left it. Maybe in my car, or something? I can go check if you want.
Oh, no no! We can get it. You're still working and all, so...
Yeah, give us the keys!
Okay, that's cool. I'm almost done with my shift, so I'll just meet you out there.
Dude, just butt dial her phone again, and then we can hear where it's ringing from!
Helloooooo?
POPS?!
Mordecai, hello! I was just eating this frozen ice lolly, when all of the sudden, this magical telephone thing started ringing!
(still in Margaret's car): Margaret must have left her phone at the house last night!
Ask him what flavor he is eating!
Pops, stay where you are, don't move, got it?
Oooh, I love this game!
Okay, we need to get back to the house before-
Hey guys! Did you find my phone?
Uhhh...
Yeah, back at the house!
OW!
Great! I'll go pick it up!
No! We can get it for you! I mean, the park is so far out of your way!
No, I don't mind. Besides, I'm the one that left it there!
Fine. Heh heh. We'll see you there!
(while holding on to the hood of the cart): Dude! Slow down!
(while driving): No, she can't hear that message!
Thanks Pops!
PASSWORD?!
Uhhhh, Coffee!
Dude, hurry!
Uhhhhh... what could it be?!
Music! She likes Fist Pump!
Dude! She's almost here! Try something!
Uhhhhhh...
Wait, what?
Did I win?
Ughhhh...
What the? Where are we?
Whoaaaaaa...
What?! I didn't think that warning was real!
What?!
Oh, Margaret, hello!
Hey Pops! I came to pick up my phone.
Oh, so it was YOUR phone that Mordecai and Rigby got sucked into?
Surrrrrrrre.... so, have you seen my phone?
Yes, come in, come in!
Wait, wait, wait, wait!
We can explain!
Okay, so I accidentally recorded this message on a girl, Margaret's phone.
Yeah, and we were just trying to delete it before she heard it!
Because HE'LL die of embarrassment!
Yeah, look. Margaret and I have a really complicated relationship.
Aw! We don't have time for this! Can you please delete the message?
It's over there!
Oh no. Please, I'm begging you, please delete that message!
Hm hm. Saw that one coming.
Uh, yes? Who is this?<
Don't listen to them, Margaret!
Yeah, these guys are crazy!
Mordecai? Rigby? Wait, you guys tried to hack into my phone?!
It was an accident! We didn't know it was YOUR phone!
Yeah, right!
Well, we did know, but...
But what? I can't believe you would do something like that! I TOTALLY misjudged you!
Dude, just come clean already.
Okay, look. So I sat on my phone, and accidentally-
You what? I want to hear the message!
Wait, Margaret! Please!
No, I want to hear it.
A-hanging with Margaret just-a feels so good like I knew it would. Laughing together and-a having a blast. And I hope it lasts forever!
Oh, please!
Eugh! It's worse than I thought!
Shut up!
Oh, Margaret. Oh, Margaret. Do you remember last night when our hands touched? We were grabbing for the dice and you were laughing and such...
Take one role, then take a chance on me. And maybe then you'll see how perfect we can be. Together you and me for all eternity!
Euugh! Could you please just erase me?
Okay. Maybe that's a long, long time. But a guy can dream, can't I?
At least she doesn't hate you!
Hmmm... nah. I think they learned their lesson!
Oh, yeah, we'll give you a call.
Hooray! Good show!
Hey. HEY! We made it! Thanks, Margaret!
No problem!
Yeah, thanks Margaret!
Sure thing!
Hey, Pops. I need to show you something in the other room. (He could possibly be making up an excuse so Mordecai and Margaret can talk in private)
Oooh! I love being shown things!
So, heh.
So.
So, you could go ahead and delete the message now.
Oh, no! That song is WAY to good to lose!
What? Come on!
No actually, I'm going to set it to be your personal ringtone.
You're kidding, right?
Nope. That way I can hear you singing every time you call me. So you better call me.
Oh. Uh, okay! I'll try to use my fingers next time, and not my butt! (Margaret slams the door) Rad.
Alright, Mr. Maellard gets back from vacation today, so I need you guys to clean the limousine.
Why don't we just wait 'till it rains? That's how I clean myself.
Yeah, yeah, we got it.
So, where are the keys?
Yeah.
Oh, no. I'll be holding onto these.
Aw, what?! How are we gonna listen to the radio then?
Whooooa!
Yeah, now we're talking!
Meatball suuub!
Meatball suuub!
Rigby!
Ugh! My eyeball!
Agh! It's still there!
Dude, stop moving!
(He shouts indistinctly.)
We got to get Skips.
Can you fix it?
Nope. I know a guy who runs an auto-body shop, though. He could fix it for you.
We got to get the keys from Benson.
Aw.
Poetry.
Hello? Hello?!
We're closed!
But --
We're closed!
This is an emergency! We got a limo!
You know this car?
Whooooa!
Uh, meatball sub.
Hmm. All right, it won't be easy, but I'll see what I can do. Bring her in!
Thanks so much!
You can fix this, right?!
I'm a mechanic, not a magician.
Dude, what are we gonna do?! Mr. Maellard's picking up the car in a few hours!
Face it, dude. We can't get out of this one. Let's just take it back.
Actually, I know a way to get a limo just like this one.
How?!

There's a place where he richest of the rich gather. A secret place where the limos duke it out and the winner gets a brand-new limo. Limo Demolition Derby. It's the only way you're gonna get a new limo in time, unless you boys got a million bucks handy.
(He counts the coins on his hand.) How much is a million?
We'll do it.
Whooooa!
Dude, there it is!
We have to win it.

Hang on, fellas! Let's talk strategy first. There's a couple of things you should know before you go out there. One, go for the stretch limo first. It's at a disadvantage 'cause it's too long. Two, if you see a Jeep limo, take out its back wheels. Three, it's a scientific fact that gold limos are heavy. So take it to the mud and that nugget will sink. You got all that?
Uh...
Of course you do! You two are responsible! Now go out there and win that limo so Maellard doesn't tear you limb from limb!
Chauffeurs, start your engines!
On your mark, get set, go!
Watch out, watch out!
Aw, man!
The gear is stuck!
Hello?
And you're just telling us now?
I said I was sorry.
Yeah, yeah.
Oh, and don't press the red button, it launches the missile. And you only have one, so don't use it until you really need it.
Dude, do something!
Rigby, start pressing buttons!
We...we did it!
Dude, we won!
Haha, yeah!
Limosaurus. Limosaurus.
Huh?
Limosaurus, LIMOSAURUS! LIMOSAURUS! LIMOSAURUS! LIMOSAURUS!
Dude, why's the ground shaking?
Boys, I know I keep forgetting important information, but I promise this is the last thing. To win the final round of the derby, you need to defeat a dinosaur made out of limos!
What?!
Dude, go go go!
Dude, Limosaurus is down!
Hmph, hmph! More like hunk-of-junk-osaurus!
OOHHHH!!!!
Dude, just press everything!
Pew-pew-pew!
Haha!
This is all your fault, meatball sub!
Dude. Press the red button.
Hmm, hmmm! Heheh, this looks as good as new! Thank you, Benson, great work.
Oh, it was no trouble at all. Right, guys?
Now, on to more pressing matters! Limousine lunchtime.
Ah, pastrami with extra coleslaw, I've been waiting to eat this the whole plane ride back!
What? What is it? I'm busy, here!
No!!!
