Mordecai, look!
It's a cartridge slot.
But that means we'd have to shut off the game!
Hmph.
Okay, wait.
I have never seen a place as cool as this.
Dude, look!
It's him. Maury Moto...
I think we should say something.
Maury Moto...your games...then that part when you jump up?
Invisible block? Power-up comes out?
Like, my world was changed. Thanks, man.
Thanks.
Oh, huh.
Nice.
What? No!
But we only took one per customer!
Really gotta re-insulate that. You two! I can't believe you stole my car battery for a couple stupid fabric patches!
Uh, first off - these are badges.
Yeah - rare golden game badges! They're like priceless!
Oh, well if they're so valuable, I guess I could just buy a new battery with -
No!
What do we do?
I don't know!
Into the light!
This has been the longest day of my life. First, the sprinklers were too short and the next thing I know, I'm climbing into some abandoned mall. And then there was those gibbons.
I had to talk to some crazy old knight, and punched through a wall and - man, that was really something.
Dude, if you wanted to hang out with us so bad, you could've just asked.
Give me those stupid patches!
Aw, come on!
Holy...hey, look!
Awesome...
What?
Skips, drive away right now!
Aw, man!
Why should we believe any of this nonsense? How do we even know you're telling the truth?
Ooh, hello!
Pops is much stronger than he looks. You cannot begin to comprehend the power he has within him.
What kinda fighting style are you gonna teach Pops? I think you should teach him Krav Maga.
Or Death Kwon Do!
Pops has no need for such insignificant -
Maybe he could use the Fists of Justice.
He -
Is Pops gonna get cool powers and stuff?
I thi-
Oh! Is he gonna shoot fire outta his fingers?
That's not a thing!
What kind of award does Pops get if he wins?
Yeah-yuh! We gotta go on a world tour with Pops!
Is he gonna have to go somewhere?

Enough! We need to take this seriously! Pops and Anti-Pops are the reason for the universe as we know it. Everything that exists is but a battleground for their celestial forms. Every fourteen-billion years, they battle for dominance, but they are two sides of the same coin. Their powers in perfect balance. Every time, the battle ends in stalemate, and the universe resets anew. But this time, it can be different. With my help, Pops can break the cycle and save this universe.
Titan? Universe? I'm just Pops! This doesn't seem right.
I dunno, Pops. This sounds really serious. I think you have to do this.
But I don't wanna fight anyone!
You can and will!
Wait a minute, how do we know this isn't all a load?
Yeah, we want proof!
Oh, you want proof? Every time the cycle starts over, I get a tattoo on my...
Uh...
What's happening right now?
...body!
Frankly, I'm running out of space. I will unlock your power, Pops.
Training starts now!
Let us begin.
Socks?
Yes. My socks, Pops. We must fold them.
Okay...
Chase the rabbit 'round the tail, then insert his fluffy -
No! Do as I do!
Now, you try!
Fold...tuck...then place in hamper...
What the heck? This is lame!
Yeah! Where's the cool training we were promised?
Hmm...hmph, hmph, hmph, hmph, hmph!
Now it is time to make lemonade.
That sounds delightful!
No! Not delightful! Grab a lemon!
Now squeeze it.
Clear your mind. The lemon is your foe. He does not want you to yield his precious golden fluids, so you must crush him!
Good. Yes...now do that a million times!
Ahh...Pops. Look at these bushes. So unkempt! Now, simply do as I do.
You see? Easy.
But, I don't want to hit a tree.
Just do it!

Okay, okay. This feels like a good place to take a ten minute break. But, before we resume, I want you to ponder this ancient haiku: Darkness ahead strong, my body frail like dried leaves, wise master so cool.
Okay...
This guy is full of it!
Yeah! I think Earl's a big fat fraud!
Oh, you got something to say?
Yeah, when are you gonna teach him something useful?
I am.
Whatever, dude. While you're folding socks, Anti-Pops is probably off somewhere learning how to shoot fire out of his fingers!
You're really hung up on that fire out of the fingers thing.
Because it's cool!
Right?
Knock it off, dude!
Okay! You're legit!
I don't wanna let you down, but I'll never be as strong as Anti-Pops.
Stop talking to that sad picture! Break's over!
Wax apply, wax remove, wax apply, wax remove.
Now, let's try it with water in the buckets.
Psst, Pops!
Huh?
How's training going?
Terrible! Earl hasn't taught me anything!
Haven't taught you anything!?
Busted!
Uh...I'm sorry, but it's the truth! Your training makes no sense! I think you're simply too lazy to do your own chores, and I'm fed up with being your personal chambermaid!
Also, I think you are thoroughly unpleasant!
Oh, snap!
Dang!
Oh, burn!
Oh, man!
Whoa...
Oh, no, he didn't!
I don't want to be the chosen one!
If you do not become stronger than Anti-Pops, he will he will erase everything you hold near and dear from existence!
I refuse to train!
What is that?
A fragment from a previous universe. It will show the consequences of your decisions.
Where am I?
Oh my! It's...it's...me!
Yeah! Go! Go, Titan Pops! Remember our training!
Stop! Stop fighting!
Bad show!
No!
Oh, dang it. This part always hurts.
Huh? Fellows! The universe, it's vanishing!
No!!!
Pops, are you okay?
Pops, dude, what is it?
Pops, you alright?
What happened?
Pops, what happened? Are you okay?
I just want things to go back to how they were!
Pops, wait!
What do you show him?
Only the truth.
Not cool, Earl.
Sometimes, the truth is not cool.
Ugh, whatever. Let's go get Pops.
Get to my safe place! Get to my safe place! Get to my safe place! Get to my safe place!
Where are you?
Hey, don't run away!
Pops!?
Pops, come back!
Pops!?
Hey, what's that? Dude, over there!
Hey Pops, you okay?
What is this place?
It's okay to be scared, Pops. We're all scared.
Yeah, I'm like, super scared.
I'm not gonna pretend that we can relate, but we know you can do this, and we'll be with you every step of the way.
That goes for all of us.
Yeah, we got your back, Pops.
Yes, Pops. We are all here to help you. You needn't be afraid. Hey Pops.
Yes?
Catch!
Whoa.
Cool...
What the...?
That's way cooler than Krav Maga.

Alright, listen up, something really big is really happening to me today. It might change my life forever, I won't bore you with the details, but you're gonna unsupervised for a few hours, so do whatever you want for lunch.
What was that?
We didn't say anything.
Oh, okay. Huh. You gu..you guys were asking how...
Nope. Weren't asking you anything.
Gene? As in Gene the rival park manager?
Gene sucks!
That maybe true, but I've never been invited and it is a huge honour, not to mention very exclusive.
This sounds bad.
So you think I'm not good enough to be included. It has to be a prank!
No, that's not it.
It's just Gene.
So what are we gonna do about the lunch?
I was thinking pizza subs.
Well, I don't trust Gene, we gotta follow Benson.
Let's keep that on the table, but first, rescuing Benson.
Can we call it "Operation: Save Benson Before Getting Pizza Subs"?
Yeah, we'll vote on it in the car.
Aw, man, raking? I'd rather play video games.
Yeah, or how about Punchies?
Oh, I fell!
Is the bug picking up Benson's voice?
This makes me feel uncomfortable.
I'm not ready to know Benson like this.
Gah, 'bout six or one, half a dozen of the other, really. (Sees Benson) Hey hey! Benson's here, it's Benson, everybody!
Haha, yeah, speaking of leaves, earlier today I was showing my workers how to pick up leaves, but, I was a drummer, so, you know.
Ha, order up!
Chicken and waffles? Ugh, I'm so hungry, I never had a lunch break! Skips, can we get lunch break; there's a pizza sub place two blocks away!
Pizza subs are not on the table, but we should really stay put for now.
(Frustrated) Ugh, Fine! But if I starve to death, I blame you!
(From walkie talkie) Now, let's talk time sheets. Alphabetical, or chronological?
Well, I'm really more of an alphabetical kind of guy. You know what they say, A to Z, time ain't free!
(From walkie talkie) And so then I said, what are you, a mana-germaphobe?
Where'd the sound go?
Oh, something must have happened!
Gene hit the bug! That sly devil!
(Pretending to be disappointed) Looks like we'll have to go inside, closer to the food... Oh no...⸮
Uhh... No thanks.
No.
Fine. Fine, we'll have a, uh... Raspberry bumblebee.
Ugh, why didn't you order any food?
Because we're not here to eat!
But this place smells like... It smells just like food!
-Cameras, hidden mirrors, I try to keep an eye on them at all times.
And pizza subs are a kind of food! (slams his fists down on the table) I can't take it!
(Covers Rigby's mouth) Shush! Everybody down!
We're in too deep!
Yeah, this was a bad idea Rigby had. Let's go!
Ugh! Stop hitting me! Your elbows are weirdly pointy!
Hey!
[gasp]
(Whispering) Hey! You stop, you stop right there! What do you think you're doing? This is my special luncheon!
(Whispering) We're trying to help! We really think you're being set up!
No! They're just taking me out to lunch, someone's finally... (looks around anxiously) someone's finally recognizing my hard work!
(Whispering) But Gene!
You don't get it! I've made sacrifices! Stick hockey, drumming, this is all I have left! Park managing is my life! You guys want to make me look like a jerk in front of my colleagues!
Sorry, Benson, we didn't know.
No! You leave me alone! You go rake those leaves, don't make me tell you twice!
I'm feeling something almost as bad as hunger. I think it's guilt, guys.
It's us! We're the jerks!
Chill, Pops! Let's just go home and try to forget this ever happened!
[Sighs] He looks so happy with them.
They got Benson!
Oh man, what are they doing to him?
Looks like some sort of sacrifice.
We gotta get in somehow!
Jackpot, bro.
[Gasps] They catered with pizza subs? At least they have taste!
Your attention! Attention, please!

With the mask of silence secured, we may begin the ritual. Brotherhood, loyalty, discipline, these are not things you learn, these are things you are! Most people are like so much sludge in the gutters, filling space until they're expunged! But we are like the sunrise, cascading over the pines, silently illuminating the world, yeah!
No, Pops, this is bad.
Oh no!
We are park managers, and what stands before us is litter, to be composted!
Now!
Huh?! Stop them!
Thank us later! Come on!
Follow them! Follow them in your vehicles! Tear them apart!
Bad show!
Nope, you're taking a taxi, Steffen.
I hate this club.
"Operation: Save Benson", success!
That's not the name we agreed on.
No need to thank us, Benson.
Benson! I can't believe I thought you were lodge material!
Lodge material? See?! That's what "compost" means! They were gonna chop him up to build a cabin!
You work in a park, and you don't know what "compost" means?
What?!
Those are the worst employees I've ever seen! Therefore, you're the worst park manager I've ever seen! Those knuckleheads couldn't tell a lawn mower from a leaf blower!
Don't throw my employees into this! They were just trying to protect me because you're a crazy person who's done nothing but prank us!
Yeah, and...?
I thought I wanted to be a lodge member, but I wouldn't abandon my employees to fit into overblown kids' clubhouse! Now, if you would please excuse yourselves, we close at 6:00 on Thursdays.
Ha! Benson, you old so-and-so! That was the final test!
You and your employees have truly displayed our core values! Welcome to the Lodge Benson!
I'm... In?
BOO! GENE'S THE WORST!
Benson Doesn't Hate That Stuff!
Heh.
No way, Gene!
Can I get a half caff Americano please?
No arguments here. This is one of my favorite coffee spots.
I know the one! The owner's super chill and they have a huge "Down-Tempo Electronica" section.
Wow! Cool!
Um, do you maybe wanna head over there with me after a coffee?
Yeah, sure.
Me too!
Whoa, this is so cool.
Yeah, there's something about watching animals that makes me feel really peaceful.
Yeah... me too.
Yeah! Me too!
Today was really fun! I never met anyone I had so much in common with.
Me too! I mean, me either.
Hey, me too!
That seems like the most logical way to stay in touch.
I hope I see you in four years.
Me too.
Relax, man. It's natural.
Rigby's right. It's not healthy to hold it in.
(sighs) Just cancel it already!
Yo, is my tax return in there?
No, but Fives, this came for you. (Fives takes the busted card) Now, all of you, stop eating donuts and get back to work! (walks away)
(reading the card) "Let's meet..." (suddenly gasps)
What is it?
It's the postcard from Celia!
Whoa!
Who's Celia?
Only the coolest girl I ever met! Four years ago we made a promise to meet when she was done with school in Prague, and now she's back!
Nice bro, nice.
Yeah, that's really awesome.
So when are you gonna see her?
Oh, uhh, (takes a look at the postcard) uhh...uhh...wait! I don't know! I can't read anything else on the card! It's too busted up! What am I gonna do?!
Whoa, bro. Don't worry. We just need to take a better look. Let's take it inside.
Uhh...uhh...okay, yeah.
Uhh...okay. So, how about...(tries looking at different angles of the postcard) I got nothing.
Dude, what happened to it? It looks like it was in someone's mouth.
(takes the postcard) I don't know. I can't tell with all these change of address stamps.
Oh, yeah. I moved around a lot. It probably got stuck in the postal system for a while.
Uh, yeah. I think we got that part.
"I'm something something, something somethiiiiing you! Best wishes, Celia."
Ugh! Thanks for getting us nowhere.
March 20?
Turn off the TV!
I hate to say it, (holds up postcard) but we might not be able to figure this out.
These are some of the best forensic guys I know. If they can't decipher the letter, no one can.
I really appreciate you help me out.

Don't thank me yet. While they're the best forensic guys I know, they're also the best chop-busting guys I know. If you want their help, you're gonna have to chop-bust 'em right back. (enters a room with two men) Hey, Wes! Westley!
(nodding) You guys...
Ah, this is my brother Hi Five and his friends. They need your help readiing letters on a postcard.
Well, we can't read it 'cause the card's all busted up.
Yeah! Did your mom dress you this morning?
Alright, not bad. Hey Wes, how'd you grow a moustache on your butt? Oh, wait, that's your face! Ehhhh!
I mean...I... I thought...
Sorry, sorry! (looks up) Uh, is this okay, or-
Oh no, sir! Sorry, sir!
Alright, you got me.
What does it say? Where am I supposed to meet her?
Keep it together, bro! (to Wes and Westley) Come on, man. There's gotta be something else you can do.
You can do it.
Yeah, man. We'll help you.
Thanks, guys.
Alright, let's roll!
Aaah! Why are they all chain restaurants?
(picks up the walkie-talkie) What's the sitch?
Seven? You think it's on Seventh Street?
There's one on Seventh Street in Magnolia!
On it!
It's locked!
(noticing a sign) Ugh, it says they're fumigating this week.
Aw, sick!
Now what am I gonna do? Guh! (pounds the door) No! (starts repeatedly knocking on the door) Celiaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!
Fives, take it easy!
She's not in there, man!
Sorry, dude. It's just not the right one.
Guys, come here!
No! Not now!
That place is in the shopping centre across town.
But there's only 10 minutes left! We won't make it with the traffic!
(with a serious tone) Guess I better start flooring it then.
How are we gonna get past this?!
Looks like we're gonna have to cut through the mall.
But isn't that illegal?
(serious tone) Not when you're a cop it isn't. (suddenly makes a break through the mall as Hi Fives screams. The people at the mall clear the way.) Remain calm, citizens! Routine procedure!
There it is! (We are shown the exact restaurant) There's still time, bro!
They said she was there, but it's past 7 now. I was too late.
Dude, not the time.
Look, Fives, I'm sorry you-
Thanks, but, I just wanna be alone right now. (floats off)
We're still gonna get Pizzanini's, right? (Mordecai punches him) Oww!
Can I get a half caff Americano?
(approaching HI Fives) Good choice. That's my favourite.
Celia!
I wasn't sure what to do, and I just wound up here.
Me too.
Woah, that's pretty cool, Pops.
Hey, we could've gotten it!
Alright, Pops. What gives? What are we all doing up here?
Yeah, what's the deal, Pops?
Okay, okay. If you trust them, then you should have no problem performing a trust fall.
Please tell me you're joking...
Aww, sweet! Benson's totally gonna trust us after this!
Later, Pops!
WOOOOOOOOAH!!
(groans)
You guys better not screw up.
Dude, you can't take off your blindfold!
It was just an accident, it won't happen again.
Sure it won't.
Come on, Benson. Just put the blindfold back on and try again.
I'm better off on my own.
You're supposed to let us lead you.
You know, if you would've just given us a chance on these trust exercises we would've made it to the bottom of the mountain by now.
I gave you a chance, and I fell.
Yeah, but we caught you.
No you didn't! Falling on top of you doesn't count.
I think it does.
No it doesn't!! Besides, I'm not going to put my life in the hands of two incompetent slackers.
Pfft...
Yeah, it's not our fault you have trust ♪issues♪..
Benson, you can't see anything! Can't you at least wait till morning?
Rock. Rock. Bigger rock.
Will you two just... huh?
It's a sign.
Uh, Benson, this is definitely not the main path.
It's gotta be, why else would they put a sign here?
But the sign says "Keep Out: Sacred Animal Burial Ground".
This doesn't look right, Benson. Let's turn back.
I know what I'm doing, unlike you two.
Woah... Wha...?
What's going on?
What's going on?!
Oh, nice try Mordecai. I've heard you make that voice before.
What? That's not me.
You're not gonna fool me with that old trick.
Benson, we've gotta get outta here.
Yeah, come on, come on!
Hey!
Did we lose them?
I don't-
It's all broken...
(His mouth is in pain, as he cannot utter a word except for small sounds. He removes a leave stuck inside his mouth and the leave turn out to be poison ivy much to his horror)
Nope, definitely not us.
I don't have much of a choice, do I?
Alright, Rigby, grab that rope over there and take it to Benson.
Benson, you're gonna run as fast as you can, and when I say 'jump', you're gonna do a little jump.
Jump? Jump how far?
Not far.
You better know what you're doing!
What's happening?! I thought you said it wasn't that far!
Front flip or backflip?
What?! Forward and a backflip?
Who's there?!
There's nowhere else to go but down!
Do you trust us?
Do you trust us with your life?
I'm sorry! I should have trusted you!
It's okay, Benson! Sometimes we slack off!
I love you guys!
We love you too!!
(indistiguishable gibberish that closely resembles "I love you!")
Take us to the hospital.
C'mon Muscle Man! Not the pants.
